_tierWhy_20260908: ⛔ AN AUTHORED TIER, BECAUSE THE DERIVATION'S CEILING IS `heroic` AND THESE ARE AT OR ABOVE IT. ⚑ CCode 2026-09-08: 'a derivation must never mint a legendary — a REGEX IS NOT ENTITLED TO MAKE THAT CLAIM', and the corollary is that ANY BEING ABOVE HEROIC MUST CARRY THE FIELD. ⚠️ AND THE DERIVATION WOULD HAVE BEEN WRONG IN BOTH DIRECTIONS HERE: `warden` derives REGIONAL, so `veth_ondra` — L33, 24 crafts, THE HIGHEST-LEVEL AUTHORED PERSON IN THE VALLEY — would have been demoted three rungs. ⛑ Their authored `level` was protecting them and only by accident; a level and a tier are two fields and both should say the same thing. ⚑ HERE: ⚑ Coliseum champion, L26, 'has never been hit in this arena.'
